dataset: MultiNLI 1.0 (Williams, Nangia, Bowman, NAACL 2018), validated five-vote dev_matched + dev_mismatched splits read from multinli_1.0.zip. Each valid-gold row is bucketed by its normalised gold (entailment / neutral / contradiction) and tallied for unanimity and individual annotator agreement; '-' (no-majority) rows are counted separately. Uses the same census module as audit 42 (SNLI), so the two per-class tables are directly comparable.
note: Unanimous = all five annotators chose the gold. 'individual_agreement_rate' is the share of individual annotator labels equal to the gold (the MultiNLI paper's agreement statistic), reported per class and in aggregate. P1 is a by-construction check (expected to hold, as audit 38 verified across all splits); P2 and P3 are directional bets, a finding either way, with the exact per-class rates reported. This audit measures annotator AGREEMENT per class, not label correctness: a unanimous gold can still be wrong and a '-' row is not an error. It covers only the validated dev_matched + dev_mismatched splits (MultiNLI train is single-annotator, see audit 38). This audit reads the official release and reports counts; it does not redistribute MultiNLI.
